_comment: Gate thresholds for `python tools/kit.py loadtest`. dir=max means lower is better. Tune per game; keep the defaults strict for a 20 Hz movement tick. Numbers are per region database.

reducer_errors.why: reducers should not fail under normal load

reducer_p99_ms.why: tail latency; spikes read as rubber-banding

tick_health.avg_lateness_us.why: scheduler lateness vs a 50 ms tick: >25% warn, >50% fail

updates_per_bot_per_sec.why: AOI fan-out per client; past this, quantize, shrink AOI, or lower send rate
